title: Implement a min-stack in Go
description: Implement a stack with O(1) Push, Pop, Top, and GetMin using an auxiliary min-tracking stack.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement MinStack in minstack.go:
- Fields: `stack []int` (main stack) and `minStack []int` (parallel min tracker)
- NewMinStack: return &MinStack{} with empty slices
- Push(val): append val to stack; append val to minStack only if minStack is empty or val <= current min
- Pop: remove top from stack; if top equals current min, also remove from minStack
- Top: return last element of stack
- GetMin: return last element of minStack
All 3 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
